title: The Quiet Little Drum
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A drum that can't make noise discovers the beauty of quiet sounds.
long_description: In Mr. Harmony's music shop, every instrument has a voice except Drum. He tries and tries but can't make a sound. Feeling broken and left out, he rolls into a quiet corner. But when Lily, a kind little girl, takes him home, Drum discovers he has a special gift—he can make quiet sounds, the kind you have to listen very carefully to hear. When a lost kitten needs help, Drum uses his quiet tapping to alert Lily, proving that even the softest sounds can make a big difference. A gentle story about listening, self-acceptance, and the beauty of quiet.

main_characters.name: Drum
main_characters.description: A small, round drum with a wooden body and a soft leather top. He has a gentle, almost sad expression.

main_characters.name: Lily

main_characters.name: Violin

main_characters.name: Trumpet

main_characters.name: Kitten
main_characters.description: A small, lost kitten with soft fur and a sad meow.
